lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct, high-contrast vertical white stripes are visible; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section but increases significantly at the anterior and posterior boundaries of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 5th stripe from the anterior, splitting approximately three-quarters of the way up towards the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first three anterior stripes and the final two posterior stripes terminate mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 distinct white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch, with a higher density of 4 spots concentrated near the posterior edge of the thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align in a semi-vertical geometric line trailing down toward the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast white 'V' shaped chevron between the medial canthi of the eyes; distinct white horizontal patch on the ventral throat; white transverse banding on the mid-metacarpal region of the forelimb.
